origin: ground at wheel contact, centred on chassis

animationNotes.drive: 2 s wheel-roll loop, in place; translate fire_truck along +Z at 3.14 m/s
animationNotes.ladder_extend: 4 s; raise base, then telescope overlapping nested truss stages
animationNotes.ladder_retract: 4 s inverse deployment; play once, clamp last frame
animationNotes.lights: 1 s alternating emissive chip visibility loop; opaque housings remain

provenance: Original mesh and materials; existing repository truck assets inspected as references only; no copied geometry, textures or third-party marks.
